tagline: One tap per link, and she never has to touch it again.

flow.title: Tell us where
flow.text: Your name, an email for replies, and the links. Nothing asks what the images show.

flow.title: Review requests
flow.text: One request per platform. Gemini writes the greeting. Every legal section is fixed text. You sign once.

flow.title: Send
flow.text: Email opens ready to send, or the platform's form fields are ready to paste. You send, or give one-time consent to auto-send.

flow.title: Track the 48 hours
flow.text: Live clocks. Reminders drafted at 24h and 44h. Miss the deadline and an FTC complaint is drafted from the evidence log.

flow.title: It keeps going
flow.text: Re-checks every 3 days. If it comes back, it is re-filed citing the original request. Paste any reply and it is read for you.

tools.name: Resolver
tools.does: Finds the platform's own removal channel, grounded with Google Search. Needs sources and 70% confidence, or it says it couldn't confirm.
tools.never: Never sees the link path, only the hostname.

tools.name: Drafter
tools.does: Writes the short greeting at the top of each request. The five legal sections are fixed text.
tools.never: Gets platform names only. Never your name, email or links.

tools.name: Watcher
tools.does: Runs the 48-hour clock, drafts the 24h and 44h reminders, and the FTC complaint if the deadline passes.

tools.name: Rechecker
tools.does: Every 3 days reads each page as text, confirms removals, re-files re-uploads.
tools.never: Media is stripped before it looks. Unsure means it asks you.

tools.name: Reader
tools.does: Paste a platform's email and it says removed, acknowledged or rejected. You confirm.
tools.never: The reply is classified and discarded, never stored.

tools.name: Detector
tools.does: Scans the account you already reported for more posts, reading captions and comments only. You confirm each match.
tools.never: Never opens an image. Demo runs on a sandbox account.

safety.title: Links only
safety.text: Never sees, uploads or downloads an image. No vision model. A test proves no path can store image bytes.

safety.title: Never searches for you
safety.text: Two lookups exist: which platform a link is on, and your own name on Google, where every result waits for your OK.

safety.title: Never logs in or posts
safety.text: Opens the platform's own form with the fields ready. Never contacts the uploader.

safety.title: Under 18? It stops
safety.text: Routes to NCMEC's Take It Down, stores nothing, never creates a case.

safety.title: You sign every request
safety.text: A fixed good-faith statement and your /s/ signature. The model can never grant consent.

safety.title: Quick exit wipes it
safety.text: Esc clears the browser and deletes the server copy, then leaves.
